g.text: Bands and staff on the floor
SpacetimeDB: claim state; the Decision Engine's code decides every amount
The Decision Engine: Claude agents, run as jobs by bandit-workers
The organizer, in the host portal's Claims tab
The Decision Engine: insurance claim flow (Hyphenate track)
The Decision Engine is the Claude agents in bandit-workers plus the code that decides coverage, amounts and learned rules. An incident becomes a claim with no form.
The venue's liability policy pays. Claude reads the bill and judges causation, but never sees or sets an amount: code prices every line and decides the route. The
organizer's approval teaches a rule that settles the next similar claim by itself.
Live learning, as the judges see it
1. A live fall becomes a claim. No rule exists yet, so it waits for the organizer in the host
2. A late note makes the first tap fail as stale; the organizer approves again. The payout lands in
the wallet and rule v1 is created with the organizer's name on it.
3. Maya (band 91) falls the same way and settles in seconds under rule v1.
4. A fake with witnesses in another zone is refused by code with every check listed.
Edge cases, live or in the stress test
Injury happened at home: Claude says doubt, a person decides.
Witness bands in another zone: refused at claim open as witness_zone, zones side by side.
Amount changed while approving: fails closed as stale.
Same bill scanned again: marked duplicate, pays nothing, refused as zero_payout.
Injured person is venue staff: refused at claim open; workers' comp applies.
Three or more hurt in one incident: no claim settles by rule; the organizer decides each.
Only code at claim open and the organizer refuse.
Accuracy run and scorecard, before judging
bandit-claims plants 3 rounds of 12 genuine claims and 6 decoys (sitting down, dropped phone, fake witnesses)
through the same reducers a medic uses.
Straight-through rate per round, rising as rules are learned.
Dollars wrongly paid on decoys: target $0.
Auto-settle precision and recall; bill-review savings; incident to payout time; human touches per claim.
Shown in the Claims tab and the Kibana dashboard BandIt claims evidence.
